ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of high-intensity (white/tan) to low-intensity (black) pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central black wedge-shaped region extending from the base; large contiguous white/tan regions on both lobes; thin black perimeter along the trailing edge; thicker black borders on leading edges and tips; isolated dark circular spot in the lower-medial section of the left lobe; dark vertical striations on the trailing edge of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate angle of 65 degrees and a vertical depth roughly equal to 25% of the total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe trailing edge is mostly linear with micro-serrations and one distinct indentation near the tip; right lobe trailing edge exhibits higher frequency irregularity with several vertical dark notches and a jagged profile near the distal end.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex upward curvature along the lower leading edge, terminating in acute, slightly recurved tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast dark textured clusters observed at both the far-left and far-right distal tips, suggesting barnacle colonization zones.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct vertical dark lines (rake marks) on the upper trailing edge of the right lobe; faint diagonal linear disruptions on the mid-section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A notable dark vertical slit or notch on the trailing edge of the right lobe; irregular dark textured masses at the tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent yellowish-tan pigmentation wash across the inner white surfaces of both lobes.
